title: SupportPathways
description: SAIA-Class S schema defining structured, non-punitive support pathways generated by the Wellbeing Engine to increase stability, reduce harm, and strengthen protective factors.

pathwayId.description: Unique identifier for this support pathway set.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when support pathways were generated.

wellbeingAssessment.description: Assessment used to determine support needs.

harmPrevention.description: Harm-prevention evaluation informing support pathway selection.

forecast.description: Predictive forecast used to determine stability and risk trends.

pathwayType.description: Category of support (emotional, environmental, relational, economic, spiritual, etc.).

priorityLevel.description: Priority level for this pathway (1 = low, 5 = urgent support).

description.description: Human-readable description of the support pathway.
